name: ucg-config-backup
description: Logs in to the local UniFi OS API of a UCG Ultra (or another UniFi OS console), triggers a config backup and downloads it on a cron schedule. The console needs no cloud connection. Old backups are deleted after RETENTION_DAYS; failures (and optionally successes) can be sent to a webhook. Progress is in the container log.

paths.name: Backup Directory
paths.description: Where the .unf backup files are stored

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: 002: new files are writable for the users group, e.g. over SMB

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Time zone for the schedule and the log

variables.name: UCG_HOST
variables.description: IP address or host name of the UCG Ultra / UniFi OS console

variables.name: UCG_USERNAME
variables.description: Local admin user dedicated to backups (no cloud/SSO account, no 2FA)

variables.name: VERIFY_SSL
variables.description: Check the console's TLS certificate (UniFi OS ships a self-signed one)

variables.name: CRON_SCHEDULE
variables.description: When the backup runs (cron: minute hour day month weekday)

variables.name: RETENTION_DAYS
variables.description: Delete local backups older than N days (0 = keep everything)

variables.name: RUN_ON_START
variables.description: Run a backup right after the container starts

variables.name: NOTIFY_ON_SUCCESS
variables.description: Also notify the webhook on success, not only on failure

variables.name: WEBHOOK_URL
variables.description: Optional: URL for POST notifications (ntfy.sh, Healthchecks.io, Home Assistant webhook). Usually contains a secret

variables.name: WEBHOOK_FORMAT
variables.description: text (plain text, ntfy.sh/Healthchecks.io) or json (structured fields, Home Assistant)
